w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Loud Beast, Big Ugly, The Redactor, Performance Review, Sweeps Week) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Callback is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🛖 Raised bins, sealed lids, clay and cool dark. The granary stands full of food that waits — smoked, dried, rendered, patient. Whatever comes, Haven eats a while longer.
A stranger at the tree line, watching. Not hiding, exactly. Measuring. They'll be gone by dusk — but they'll remember what they saw.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 🤒 Jesse is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
Herbal remedy on Jesse: the right plants, brewed dark — the feverish breaks and doesn't come back. Jesse is going to make it. (Tijjani cured them — and the camp saw it.)

w5Mentions.name: The Network Note
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Network Note.
firstContext: You work the patch with practiced hands: 16× Blackberry (1040 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Old growth. The canopy closes overhead and the light comes down in shafts. Something rustled, and decided not to be seen.
Something moves out there — The Network Note.
👁️ Owen freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Movement — a waddling opossum, playing dead (badly).

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/9/5), with 5 wave-4 and 3 wave-5 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 18 · Craft 9 · Talk 15 · Explore 30 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Rosa Mendez reached into the light and the light reached back — person and machine, two caretakers, holding the channel open between them both ways. The village endures, and the conversation does not end.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
